'''Star Tours Flight 1012''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] just before the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. Stationed at Gate 1H, the flight was scheduled to depart at 1010 hours.
